text: Refti ɓaawo dumunna, Men immini ɓaawo ɓee ɗoo Nulaaɓe, Muusaa e neene-gooto makko on Haaruuna haa e Fir'awna laamɗo Misra on e hooreeɓe dental yimɓe makko ɓen. Men immindini ɓe e Aayeeje tinndinooje e goongugol maɓɓe. Ɓe mawnintinanii gomɗingol ko o addi kon, ɓe woni yimɓe bomɓe, sabu ko ɓe yeddiri kon Alla ɓe fenni Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen.
